messages:
Anna: Quick ask — Console wants a tiny, single-line badge for client-visible failures (throttle/degrade/quota) and an expandable area for the actionable hint. Can the API provide a stable minimal surface so SDK + Console are consistent?

Mike: Right now we use HTTP codes (429, 503, 409) and some infra 5xx flavors; SDK collapses many into `TransientError` which leaves Console guessing about badge text.

Tao: Also remember we shipped 429 subcodes last qtr (burst vs budget). SDK ignores subcodes; we shouldn't force clients to parse numbers.

Jen: Proposed contract: add two small fields in the error body that are safe for clients: `status_category` (enum: \"throttle\", \"degrade\", \"quota\", \"internal_fallback\") and `short_hint` (<=120 chars). Optional `badge_text` (<=24 chars) for the compact line. Keep HTTP codes unchanged for infra semantics.

Anna: UX constraint: do NOT surface internal route/pool/node names. Hints must be user-facing (e.g., \"Retry after 2s or reduce concurrency\"). No tenant ids or PII.

Mike: Implementation note: many services only emit HTTP codes. We'll add a gateway middleware to synthesize `status_category` from routing metadata. Gate it behind a feature flag `error_cat_v1` for canary rollout.

Tao: Telemetry: include `status_category` in trace spans. Sample `short_hint` text for quality: 1% free-tier, 10% paid. Aggregate counts and region breakdowns. Internal-only fields (route variant etc.) must be under `x-internal.*` and never sent to public clients.

Jen: Example minimal payload for Console/SDK contract:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 429,
    "status_category": "throttle",
    "badge_text": "Rate-limited",
    "short_hint": "Burst limit hit. Retry in 2s or lower concurrency.",
    "retry_after": 2,
    "help_url": "https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/client-errors"
  }
}
```

Mike: SDK behavior: if server doesn't include these fields, SDK falls back to heuristics (status code + headers). Console should show a generic badge labeled \"Failure\" with tooltip \"Details unavailable — upgrade for richer hints\" for backwards compatibility.

Anna: Add a CI linter rule that scans `short_hint` and `badge_text` for forbidden tokens (pool names, internal ids). In canary it's a warning; after stable rollout it becomes blocking on main.

Tao: Security: strip any request content from hints. Enforce max length and printable char whitelist.

Mike: Headers: don't expose internal headers. Keep `x-internal-*` for logs/metrics only. No `X-Redwood-Route-Fallback` in public responses; if needed put it behind `allow-internal` and only for internal teams.

Jen: I'll update SDK mapping table and add unit tests asserting SDK never shows internal substrings in badges/hints.

deploy-bot: deploy: error-cat-middleware v1 -> canary on prod-1 :rocket:

Anna: We'll watch sampled hints for 2 hours. If any sampled `short_hint` contains internal tokens, rollback immediately.

Jen: I'll draft the runbook mapping categories -> mitigations, assign review to Tao.

Tao: Will review. Also propose a small Console card showing category distribution and a redacted sample hints widget so product can iterate on wording.

Mike: Rolling the feature flag Thursday. I'll post the rollout plan in #release-war-room and add a privacy leakage checklist.

Anna: Thanks all. Sync after canary window. End thread.
